more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain sweet baked goods.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for the assessed limited food uses.
Higher-dose animal studies identified nervous-system effects of aluminium.
more_info.overview: Sodium aluminium phosphate is a group of specified inorganic phosphate preparations containing sodium and aluminium. Its emulsifying role is to help form or maintain mixtures of oil and water in the finished food. The specified material is supplied as white powder. The specification describes it as effectively insoluble in water.
